item.title: Door County comes together to support Warrior Violet
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- For the second time this season, the battle on the Sevastopol High School basketball court will take a back seat to a much more important fight off it.

item.title: New M² Mentorship Program Taking Shape in Door County
item.description: Adam Collins -- A new mentorship initiative launching in Door County aims to connect experienced professionals with emerging leaders, entrepreneurs, and lifelong learners across the community.

item.title: Sturgeon Bay YMCA Winter 2 Aquatics Programming on the Way
item.description: Adam Collins -- The Door County YMCA is preparing to wrap up its Winter 1 programming, with Winter 2 sessions set to begin later this month.

item.title: Sevastopol School to Host 4K Developmental Screening and Child Find Event
item.description: Adam Collins -- Families in the Sevastopol School District will have an opportunity to check in on their young children's development next month during a districtwide screening event designed to connect families with early support.

item.title: Farmers focus on improvement, not settling, in conservation efforts
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- Farmers in Door and Kewaunee counties are expected to employ even more conservation strategies after more than 90 farmers, agriculture professionals, and community members attended the Peninsula Pride Farms Annual Meeting on Tuesday at Lambeau Field.

item.title: Fish Creek rolls out welcome mat for Winterfest
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- If you count cherry spitting, toilet seat and bike flinging, and stumpf fiddling among your hobbies, Fish Creek is the place to be this weekend.

item.title: Officials Urge Drivers to Give Snowplows Space After Multiple of Crashes
item.description: Adam Collins -- After a series of crashes involving snowplows across the state, Wisconsin transportation officials are reminding drivers to slow down and give plow operators room to work.

item.title: Sen. Johnson weighs in on ICE, budget talks during teletown hall
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) activity in Minnesota and federal budget negotiations dominated U.S. Sen. Ron Johnson's teletown hall earlier this week.

item.title: Master Gardeners to Present Rain Garden Program in February
item.description: Adam Collins -- The Door County Master Gardeners continue the Growing Together Education Series this month with a program focused on rain gardens and their role in protecting local water quality.

item.title: Rotary Club Scholarship Applications Open
item.description: Adam Collins -- Door County students preparing for life after high school have two opportunities for financial support as the Rotary Club of Sturgeon Bay opens applications for its 2026 scholarship programs.
